case_set_down.what: deep crouch, reaching out to the front-left so the left hand meets the ground clear of the boot, small settle, stand up; the torso leads on the way down and the legs lead on the way up
case_set_down.use: both setting the case down (release at 0.9 s) and picking it up (grab at 0.9 s); set walk and idle weights to 0 while it plays

walk_stoop.use: crouched walk for the habitat hatches (1.43 m tall): knees bent about 60 degrees, torso leaning forward, top of the suit at 1.35 m. Same loop length and foot timing as 'walk', so run both and cross-fade their weights. Walk it at about 0.45 m/s. The Z-2 helmet is part of the rigid upper torso, so the visor tilts down with the lean; that is how the real suit would behave.
walk_stoop.reference: partner.visitHabitat and partner.update in src/main.js: the stoop fades in where habitat.duck() > 0.15

player_color.how: factor = z2_accent_mask.png sampled with the model UV; baseColor = mix(baseColor, playerColor * (0.35 + 0.95*luminance(baseColor)), factor)
player_color.note: mask = upper-arm bands, thigh bands, boot rings and helmet ring. The NASA and flag patches are never recoloured.

credit: Z-2 spacesuit model: NASA (NASA 3D Resources). Rig, animations and accent mask added for Marswalk.

first_person_legs.textures: none inside; reuse the baseColor texture and z2_accent_mask.png from z2_astronaut.glb (same UVs)
first_person_legs.animations: same names and timing as the full astronaut (walk, idle)
first_person_legs.placement: hips 0.10 m behind the eye, +0.22 m * sin(look-down angle); feet on the ground; faces walking direction
first_person_legs.boot_dust: shader uniform uSuitDust 0..1 (default 0.6), tints rest-pose height 0.02-0.50 m with regolith colour [0.36,0.20,0.11] linear

notes.shoulder_patches: the flag and mission patches and the suit surface under them are one rigid plate on the upper-arm bone, so they stay flat in every pose
notes.filler: inner geometry (waist tube, hip and ankle spheres) closes the gaps between the suit's separate shells in deep poses such as the crouch
